headword: {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}

definitions.explanation: A married woman who does not have paid employment outside the home and devotes herself to household management and childcare.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}だった。
examples.english: My mother was a full-time housewife.

examples.japanese: {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}の{数|かず}は{年々|ねんねん}{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: The number of full-time housewives is decreasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {子育|こそだ}てが{落|お}ち{着|つ}いたので、{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}から{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}したいと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: Now that childcare has settled down, I'm thinking about returning to work from being a full-time housewife.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {専業|せんぎょう} (exclusive occupation) and {主婦|しゅふ} (housewife). Commonly discussed in the context of changing social roles, work-life balance, and demographics in Japan. The male equivalent is {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ} (stay-at-home husband), written with a different kanji for the last character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}{世帯|せたい} (single-income household with a stay-at-home wife)
- {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}から{働|はたら}きに{出|で}る (to enter the workforce after being a housewife)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主婦|しゅふ}: housewife — broader term that includes both working and non-working wives
- {共働|ともばたら}き: dual-income couple — the opposite household arrangement
